name: The Poisoned Laboratory
description: An abandoned alchemist's workshop filled with dangerous fumes, volatile chemicals, and the mad alchemist's failed experiments

laboratory.entrance.name: Collapsed Entrance Hall
laboratory.entrance.description: The entrance to the laboratory is partially collapsed. Broken glass vials litter the floor, and a faint chemical smell hangs in the air. To the north, you hear bubbling liquids and smell acrid smoke.

laboratory.storage.name: Alchemical Storage
laboratory.storage.description: Shelves line the walls, filled with labeled bottles and ingredients. A large iron door to the east is marked with a skull symbol. The western passage leads to what sounds like hissing steam. To the north, a reinforced wooden door bars entry to what appears to be a specimen chamber.

laboratory.laboratory.name: Main Laboratory
laboratory.laboratory.description: The heart of the alchemist's workshop. Bubbling cauldrons, distillation equipment, and mysterious glowing liquids cover every surface. A sickly green gas seeps from cracked flasks on the northern workbench. Across a bubbling vat of acid, a brass lever gleams on the far wall. Two goblin scavengers lurk among the bubbling equipment, drawn by the smell of alchemical reagents.

environmental_hazard.description: Green poison gas fills the room!
environmental_hazard.effect: All creatures in the room at the start of their turn must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of their next turn.

interactions.name: Pull the brass lever
interactions.description: A brass lever on the far wall, across the bubbling acid vat. Too dangerous to reach by hand.

action.text: The spectral hand reaches across the acid vat and pulls the lever. A hidden panel slides open in the wall, revealing a small cache!

laboratory.furnace_room.name: Furnace Chamber
laboratory.furnace_room.description: A massive furnace roars in the center of this sweltering room, used to heat alchemical reactions. The heat is intense. A large wolf, its fur singed and eyes glowing red, lies near the furnace beside a pile of treasure. The beast's breath carries the acrid smell of sulfur. A low archway to the north vents thick clouds of scalding steam from the boiler beyond.

environmental_hazard.effect: Creatures without fire resistance suffer 1d6 fire damage at the start of each turn.
environmental_hazard.note: Potion of Fire Resistance prevents this damage

laboratory.machine_gallery.name: Collapsed Machine Gallery
laboratory.machine_gallery.description: A workroom of toppled brass apparatus and overturned shipping crates, lit clearly by a sputtering work-lamp that still clings to one wall. The wreckage is chest-high in places — more than enough to crouch behind and break an onlooker's line of sight while leaving your own view of the room unobstructed. A skeletal sentry, reassembled from mismatched bones, scrapes back and forth across the open floor, oblivious to anyone tucked among the machinery.

laboratory.sanctum.name: The Mad Alchemist's Sanctum
laboratory.sanctum.description: The alchemist's private laboratory, filled with his most dangerous experiments. The air crackles with volatile energy. Archibald the Mad, a twisted figure in stained robes, stands at his workbench surrounded by volatile vials and bubbling concoctions. His bloodshot eyes gleam with madness as he mutters incomprehensibly over his work.

laboratory.specimen_chamber.name: Specimen Preservation Chamber
laboratory.specimen_chamber.description: A cold room lined with glass tanks containing preserved creatures floating in murky alchemical solutions. Ice crystals cover the walls from some failed refrigeration experiment. Faded writing covers one of the frost-covered walls. A skeleton warrior, animated by residual alchemical energies, stands guard among the specimen jars, its bones clicking softly as it patrols.

interactions.name: Read the wall inscription
interactions.description: Faded writing covers the frost-covered wall. It's too dark to make out the words.

action.text: With proper illumination, you can read the inscription: 'Specimen 47 - DO NOT THAW. Regenerative properties unstable. Weakness: fire.' This knowledge could prove useful against the preserved creatures.

laboratory.boiler_room.name: Steam-Choked Boiler Room
laboratory.boiler_room.description: A ruptured boiler floods this cramped chamber with roiling clouds of scalding steam. Visibility drops to nothing more than an arm's length ahead, and shapes dissolve into the white haze. The dense vapor would hide a creature completely from anyone more than a few feet away.
